Βοός and Βοές (RV, Βοάζ, Rec. Βοόζ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בֹּעַז), 
 Boaz (Rut.2:1): Mat.1:5, Luk.3:32.†
 (AS)

γέρων, -οντος, ὁ, 
 [in LXX for זָקֵן ;] 
an old man: Jhn.3:4.†
 (AS)

Ἀβραάμ (Heb. אַבְרָהָם), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἄβραμος, -ου; MM, VGT, see word), 
 Abraham (Gen.17:5 al.): Mat.1:1, 2 al.
 (AS)

δαμάζω 
 [in LXX: Dan.2:40 (חֲשַׁל) * ;] 
to tame, subdue: Mrk.5:4, Jas.3:7; metaphorically, τ. γλῶσσαν, Jas.3:8 (Field, Notes, 237f.).†
 (AS)

δια-σπείρω 
 [frequently in LXX for פּוּץ, etc. ;] 
to scatter abroad, disperse: Act.8:1, 4 11:19.†
 (AS)

δι-υλίζω
 (δια, ὑλίζω, to strain) [in LXX: Amo.6:6 * ;] 
__1. to strain thoroughly (Archytas; Am., l.with). 
 __2. Later, to strain out: figuratively, Mat.23:24.†
 (AS)

ἐπι-γίνομαι (see: γίνομαι) 
 [in LXX: Ep. Jer.47:1-7, 3Ma.2:6 * ;] 
to arrive, arise, come on: Act.28:13.†
 (AS)

Εὐνίκη (Rec. -νείκη), -ης, 
 Eunice, Timothy's mother: 2Ti.1:5.†
 (AS)

θώραξ, -ακσς, ὁ 
 [in LXX chiefly for שִׁרְיוֹן and cogn. forms ;] 
a breastplate: Rev.9:9, 17; θ. τ. δικαιοσύνης, Eph.6:14 (cf. Isa.59:17, Wis.5:18-19); θ. πίστεως, 1Th.5:8.†
 (AS)

καθότι
 (= καθ᾽ ὅ τι), 
 adv., [in LXX: Exo.1:12, 17 (אֲשֶׁר), Tob.1:12, Jdth.2:13, al. ;] 
__1. in dl., according as, just as (Ex, l.with): Act.2:45 4:35. 
 __2. In late Gk. = διότι (Tob, l.with), because: Luk.1:7 19:9, Act.2:24 17:31.†
 (AS)

κατ-ανά-θεμα 
 Rec. for κατάθεμα, q.v 
 (AS)

κατα-σκευάζω 
 [in LXX: Isa.40:19, 28, (בָּרָא), etc. ;] 
to prepare, make ready: τ. ὁδόν, Mat.11:10, Mrk.1:2, Luk.7:27; οἶκον, Heb.3:3-4; σκηνήν, Heb.9:2, 6; κιβωτόν, Heb.11:7, 1Pe.3:20; pass. pf. ptcp., λαον κ., Luk.1:17.†
 (AS)

κόμη, -ης, ἡ 
 [in LXX: Num.6:5, Eze.44:20 (פֶּרַע), al. ;] 
the hair: 1Co.11:15.†
 (AS)

Μαθουσάλα (WH, -αλά), ὁ (Heb. מְתוּשֶׁלַח), 
 Methuselah: Luk.3:37.†
 (AS)

ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX: Sir prol.17 א* (ΑΒאc παρα-)* ;] 
to beget again: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, 1Pe.1:3 1:23 (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)

ἀνα-θάλλω
 (θάλλω, to flourish), [in LXX: Psa.28:7 (עָלַז), Eze.17:24 (פָּרַח hi.), Hos.8:9, Wis.4:4, Sir.5:1-15 * ;] 
to revive: Php.4:10 (of MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)

νοσσιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
 (νοσσός), 
late form of cl., νεοσσιά, 
 [in LXX chiefly for קֵן ;] 
__1. a nest of birds. 
 __2. a brood of young birds: Luk.13:34.†
 (AS)
eighty , Lat. octoginta, (Thucydides), etc.:—;ionic and doric ὀγδώκοντα, (Iliad by Homer) (ML)

ὀφείλημα, -τος, τό
 (ὀφείλω), [in LXX: Deu.24:10 (מַשָּׁאָה), I Est.3:20, 1Ma.15:8 * ;] 
that which is owed, a debt: Rom.4:4; metaphorically (as Aram. חוֺבָא חוֺב), of sin as a debt, Mat.6:12.†
 (AS)

προφητεύω
 (προφήτης), [in LXX chiefly for נָבָא ni., hith. ;] 
to be a προφήτης (which see), to prophesy: in the primary sense of telling forth the Divine counsels, Mat.7:22 26:68, Mrk.14:65, Luk.1:67 22:64, Act.19:6, 1Co.11:4-5 13:9 14:1 14:3-5 14:24 14:31 14:39, Heb.11:3; with the idea of foretelling future events (an idea merely incidental, not essential; see Lft., Notes, 83 f.), Mat.11:13, Act.2:17-18" (LXX) Act.21:9; before περί, Mat.15:7, Mrk.7:6, 1Pe.1:10; ἐπί, with dative, Rev.10:11; λέγων, Ju 14; ὅτι, Jhn.11:51.†
 SYN.: μαντεύομαι, q.v (AS)

πύρωσις, -εως, ἡ
 (πυρόω), [in LXX: Pro.27:21 (כּוּר), Amo.4:9 (שְׁדֵפָה) * ;] 
__1. a burning: Rev.18:9, 18. 
 __2. a refining or trial by fire: metaphorically, 1Pe.4:12.†
 (AS)

ἀν-οικο-δομέω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX for בָּנָה, גָּדַר ;] 
to build. again, rebuild (MM, VGT, see word): Act.15:16.†
 (AS)

ἀνομία, -ας, ἡ
 (ἄνομος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, פֶּשַׁע, תּוֹעֵבַה, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;] 
lawlessness, iniquity: Mat.7:23 13:41 23:28 24:12, Rom.6:19, 2Co.6:14, 2Th.2:3 2:7, Tit.2:14, Heb.1:9, 1Jn.3:4; in pl. (as LXX, Psa.31:1, al.; see 131., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), of acts or manifestations of lawlessness: Rom.4:7 (LXX), Heb.10:17.†
 SYN.: see: ἁμάρτημα, ἄνομος (AS)

συν-κατα-βαίνω
 (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Psa.49:17 (יָרַד), Wis.10:13, Dan LXX TH 3:49 * ;] 
to go down with: Act.25:5. In late writers also metaphorically (Wis, l.with), to condescend, on WH. see Rutherford, NPhr., 485 f.†
 (AS)

ἀπ-αίρω 
 [in LXX chiefly for נָסַע ;] 
to lift off, hence, to take away; pass.: Mat.9:15, Mrk.2:20, Luk.5:35.†
 (AS)

φάγος, -ου, ὁ
 (φαγεῖν, see: ἐσθίω) 
a glutton: Mat.11:19, Luk.7:34.†
 (AS)

φήμη, -ης, ἡ
 (φημί) [in LXX: Pro.16:2 (15:30) (שְׁמוּעָה), 2Ma.4:39, 3Ma.3:2, 4Ma.4:22 * ;] 
a saying or report: Mat.9:26, Luk.4:14.†
 (AS)

χρηστεύομαι
 (χρηστός), 
to be kind: 1Co.13:4 (eccl.).†
 (AS)

ἀδιάλειπτος, -ον 
 (διαλείπω), 
unremitting, incessant: Rom.9:2, 2Ti.1:3. (For exx., see MM, VGT, see word) †
 (AS)
